retrievalProfile.description: A retro album layout featuring a central portrait within a rounded white frame, set against a solid black background with bold, stacked sans-serif typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A structured composition where a central photographic portrait is encased in a white, rounded-corner rectangular frame. The frame is surrounded by a thick black border that serves as the canvas for high-contrast, stacked sans-serif text at the top.
coreVisualRelationships: The bold blue title dominates the upper third of the black border.
The white rounded frame creates a sharp window effect for the subject.
The subject's gaze is directed away from the camera, creating a contemplative mood.
The background within the photo frame features organic, abstract shapes in muted tones.
coreInvariants: Thick black outer border containing all typography.
White inner frame with significantly rounded top corners.
Primary title in a heavy, sky-blue sans-serif font.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The musician with an acoustic guitar is centered in the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, bright blue artist name at the top center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the blue title, move down to the white frame, and follow the musician's gaze toward the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy use of solid black in the margins to focus attention on the central image.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast between the black background and the bright blue/white elements; the photo uses muted, earthy tones.

letterConstructionRules: Heavy weight for the main title
All-caps for primary and secondary headers
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Stacked sans-serifs of varying weights and colors to create a clear hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, bold presence of the main title.
Provides the necessary mid-century grotesque feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a man with an acoustic guitar, looking off-camera, set against a background of abstract organic shapes in olive and blue. Place this image inside a white frame with rounded top corners, all centered on a solid black background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the main title in a heavy sky-blue sans-serif font above the frame. Add a smaller white sans-serif subtitle at the very top and a third line of italicized white text just above the frame's top edge.

verificationChecks: Is the main title sky blue?
Are the top corners of the white frame rounded?
Is the background outside the frame solid black?

mustRedesign: Any logos or specific brand marks
Specific artist names or song titles
The exact abstract pattern in the photo background

mustAchieve: Clean, sharp edges on the frame

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the white frame has a consistent border width.
Verify the blue title is the largest typographic element.
Check that the subject is properly centered within the rounded frame.
Confirm the black background is a flat, solid color.
recipe.reuseFormula: A [Subject] portrait inside a [Color] rounded-corner frame, set against a [Color] background with [Font Style] typography stacked at the top.
